steps.title: Sky
steps.body: The strong safety rotates down to the curl and flat; the free safety takes the deep middle.

steps.title: Buzz
steps.body: The strong safety drops inside to the hook, and a linebacker takes the flat. Harder for the quarterback to find the underneath defender.

steps.title: Cloud
steps.body: On one side the cornerback squats in the flat and the safety takes his deep third. Corners up close are the clue.

steps.prompt: One high, strong safety down. Watch where he goes. Which Cover 3?
steps.explanation: The strong safety rolls to the curl-flat: sky.

steps.prompt: One high, strong safety down. This time watch both him and the Sam. Which Cover 3?
steps.explanation: The safety buzzes inside to the hook and the Sam takes the flat: buzz.

steps.prompt: The right corner is up at 4 yards and the right safety is deep and wide. What is it?
steps.explanation: The corner takes the flat and the safety his deep third: cloud.

steps.title: Quarters is a match coverage
steps.body: In quarters, safeties read the slot receiver. If he goes vertical, the safety takes him; if he breaks short or out, the safety helps deep. Zones that turn into man once routes declare are called pattern matching.

steps.title: Palms
steps.body: A quarters variation: if the slot runs to the flat, the corner jumps him and the safety takes the outside receiver deep. Names and rules vary by staff.

steps.title: Cover 6
steps.body: Quarter-quarter-half: quarters to one side, Cover 2 to the other. Lets a defense play each side of a lopsided formation differently.

steps.prompt: Two safeties at 10, corners at 8. Name it.
steps.explanation: Tight safeties and deep corners, all four taking deep quarters: quarters.

steps.prompt: The left corner is squatting at 5, the right corner is deep at 8. What is it?
steps.explanation: Read the other safety: he sits on the hash at 10 over the deep corner, so that side is quarters, while the squatting corner's side plays halves. Cover 6. In Cover 3 cloud the other safety is in the deep middle instead.

steps.prompt: Two-high again, but the two sides don't match. Read it.
steps.explanation: One side squats and plays halves, the other plays quarters: Cover 6.

steps.statement: Pattern-matching zones can turn into man coverage once the routes declare.
steps.explanation: That's the idea: read the routes, then lock on.
